title: Trades
lead: Secondary trades between two registered investors of a series: bonds against cash, at par. An open trade blocks the next record date until you settle or cancel it.
settledBy: Settled atomically by the Solana DvP program
noMatching: Order matching, price discovery and a trading venue are not part of Qupon: the registrar records a trade the two investors have already agreed on.
noSeriesBody: Trades appear here once a series is issued.
empty: No trades in this series yet.

new.title: New trade
new.lead: Creates the trade record and admits its bond escrow in one transaction. Each investor then funds their own leg.
new.unitsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}
new.needTwo: A trade needs two active investors in this series.

row.settleHint: Both legs must be funded first
row.settleSuccess: Trade settled: bonds and cash moved in one transaction
row.confirmCancelBody: Both legs go back to their owners in one transaction and the trade stops blocking the record date.
row.confirmForceTitle: Return the bonds to the seller?
row.confirmForceBody: Use this when a normal cancel fails. The escrowed bonds go back to the seller's registered account and the trade is released. The cash leg is not moved: the buyer takes the cash back themselves with the DvP program's reclaim.
row.forcePending: Returning the bonds to the seller…
row.forceSuccess: Trade released. Bonds returned to the seller: {units}
row.fundPending: Funding the {side, select, seller {bond} other {cash}} leg (demo)…

open.title: Open trades
open.lead: Trades admitted by the registrar where you are a party. Send your leg to the escrow; the registrar settles both legs in one transaction.
open.selling: You sell {units, plural, one {# bond} other {# bonds}} for
open.buying: You buy {units, plural, one {# bond} other {# bonds}} for
open.deliver: Deliver {units, plural, one {# bond} other {# bonds}}
open.ready: Both legs funded, waiting for the registrar to settle
open.pending: Sending your leg to the escrow…

wait.open: Open secondary trades: settle or cancel them first ({count})

errors.trade_not_found: This trade is no longer open. It was settled or cancelled. Refresh the page.
errors.not_demo_investor: Demo funding works only for the demo investors whose keys the server holds. This party funds the leg from their own wallet.
